acceptanceCriteria: Each listed read either calls gitancestry.Rewritten and reports a typed unavailable state, or records why it is safe
The dogfood shallow-checkout behaviour is decided and recorded before dogfoodflow changes
Tests cover a grafted and a shallow fixture for at least one read per package
body: PR #1438 added internal/gitancestry.Rewritten and used it in appflows and extevidence freshness (EEP-V0-028). Unguarded ancestry reads remain in appflows selection.go and review.go; dogfoodflow check, batch, batch_dropped, migration, finishlane and flow; postmergeconnector, postmergemetrics, witness; contextindex range_impact.go; cmd/corvint/runs_baseline.go; breakagemap compile.go; dashboard trace.go; localcompletion, sharedpath, upgradechanges, tracerecordrepo, gitnotes, genesis; and root-commit reads (rev-list --max-parents=0). Dogfood needs a decision first: one CI job checks out with fetch-depth 2, so refusing shallow there could break it.
title: V1-1757 follow-up: guard remaining git ancestry reads against grafted or shallow checkouts
